# Code of Conduct

Keep project spaces professional, constructive, and focused on the work.
Discuss technical ideas on their merits, give actionable feedback, distinguish
verified facts from hypotheses, and respect other participants and their time.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory abuse, sexual harassment, doxxing,
deliberate disruption, and publishing private information without permission
are not acceptable. Knowingly presenting unverified vehicle definitions or
test results as verified is also unacceptable because automotive diagnostic
work can affect real vehicles.

This applies to issues, reviews, discussions, project documentation, and other
spaces operated for LINK. Maintainers may remove inappropriate content or
restrict participation proportionately. Report private conduct concerns to
`infiltratr@yandex.com`.
